title: Find distinct trees with matching leaves
description: You generate bounded expression trees and collect distinct matches for one leaf sequence.

steps.description: You store E's alternatives as tuples and recursively generate child trees. The depth check bounds expansion of nonterminals.
You combine child alternatives with a Cartesian product, which lists every combination. leaves visits the left and right children while skipping the operator slot.

steps.question: What prevents trees_for from appending the same matching tree more than once?
steps.answer: The seen set records each accepted tuple. A tree must match target_leaves and be absent from seen before it is appended.
